title: Choose the visual world for ChillCrate
question: The roll assigned the Bahi-Khata ledger. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Dark by default with a light mode; mockups of Home, Events and Catalogue/Product; live site untouched.

options.label: Bahi-Khata
options.lineage: The Indian wholesaler's red cloth-bound ledger
options.thesis: Every order is an entry in the trader's red ledger, written, ruled and totalled in front of you.
options.viewport: A ledger spread on dark madder cloth: the hook on the left page, a live order entry on the right that turns 600 guests into ruled, totalled lines, with a 'Send this entry for a quote' stamp.
options.risk: Timid cloth or ruling reads as dusty accounting software; deep red sits near the maroon-wedding cliché.

raised.raise: Three inks and the page, never a fourth: madder, turmeric, ruling red and ink blue carry every state.
Test strips: each product's price tiers show as a stepped strip before you commit a quantity.
Depth only by overlap: pages, tabs and stamps stack. No drop shadows anywhere.
Every figure is annotated: margin notes name the MOQ, lead time and next tier jump.
One monumental numeral per viewport: the guest count, the total or the carton count.

options.label: Shaadi Card
options.thesis: The quote is an invitation card: event, date, venue and guests set in foil, answered by a delivery.
options.viewport: One centred invitation card on indigo, its four foil fields (Event, Date, Venue, Guests) acting as the working quote form.
options.risk: The most familiar direction for this category, and it speaks to weddings more than to restaurants restocking every week.

options.label: Carton Wall
options.lineage: Sneaker-archive box stacks, fused with cold-store cartons
options.thesis: The catalogue is a wall of carton ends you pull from.
options.viewport: A dark cold-store wall of kraft carton ends, each listing flavour, pack-size run and carton count; the chosen carton slides half out.
options.case: Holds product clarity, because the carton is the real unit of sale; loses on audience, because cartons say warehouse, not wedding.
options.risk: Can read as a logistics catalogue and bury the events positioning.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Content steps past on cloth courses under a fixed window.
options.viewport: A destination blind stepping through delivery zones.
options.case: Loses both: buyers don't identify with depot blinds, and one-size caps type cripples product detail.
options.risk: Monitoring-room feel on a sales page.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: Orders develop station by station under amber light.
options.viewport: Stations from compose to dry across the page.
options.case: Loses both: amber gloom reads as neon-adjacent, and photography has nothing to do with ice cream.
options.kept: Test strips that preview the outcome before committing.

options.label: Layered Papercut
options.thesis: Flat colour layers pasted into depth.
options.viewport: A symmetrical roundel built from product layers.
options.case: Loses both: decorative folk craft, and it tips toward candy-kiddy.
options.kept: Depth by overlap only, never shading.

options.label: Fashion Mook Spread
options.thesis: Shingled photos with ribbon captions naming every piece.
options.viewport: Shingled product photos with ribbon labels.
options.case: Loses both: foreign to the audience, and it needs photography we don't have.
options.kept: Every item gets a named annotation.

options.label: Fashion Flagship
options.thesis: Monumental type over slow full-bleed imagery.
options.viewport: One huge serif word over a product photo.
options.case: Loses both: reads luxury retail, not wholesale, and needs real photography.
options.risk: Pretty, and empty of the information bulk buyers need.
options.kept: The courage of one monumental element per viewport.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean wholesale distributor site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A split hero (headline and button beside a product image) over a row of category cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other distributor by design.
